name: prman
description: Evidence-backed readiness decisions for code changes made with Codex

interface.shortDescription: Score and refine Codex code changes.
interface.longDescription: PRman guides Codex through deterministic evidence gates, optional preference scoring, bounded revision, and ready/revise/abstain decisions without replacing the Codex execution environment.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use PRman to evaluate the current code change and decide whether it is ready, revisable, or should abstain.
